title: AIREP profile: artifact_manifest (collection-time artifact hashes) v0.1
description: Validates a 'profiles.artifact_manifest' block: a set of evidence ARTIFACTS collected in support of a decision, each carrying a hash computed AT COLLECTION plus its collection provenance. The AIREP core hashes the decision RECORD; it does not hash the artifacts the decision was built from, so a later reader cannot tell whether the log, screenshot, or tool output the record cites is the one that was actually collected. This profile records, per artifact: a content digest, the time it was collected, where it came from, and what collected it. With it, an artifact can be re-hashed and compared to the recorded digest (content integrity since recording), and an artifact whose collected_at postdates the decision it supposedly informed is detectable. CRITICAL HONESTY: the digest proves the CONTENT is unchanged since the digest was recorded; it does NOT prove the digest was computed at the stated collected_at — that timestamp is producer-asserted unless independently anchored (an external timestamp authority, a witness, or a transparency log). Treat collected_at as a claim, not a proof of timing. It attaches only under profiles.artifact_manifest and never changes the core: deleting the profiles block leaves a valid core record (the neutrality test).

trace_id.description: Optional binding to the trace/decision this manifest supports, so a reader can join the artifacts to the decision record.

artifacts.description: The collected artifacts. An empty manifest is not a manifest — it would assert 'these are the artifacts' while listing none.

artifact_id.description: Identifier for this artifact, unique within the manifest. Two entries sharing an artifact_id are an ambiguous collection, not two records of one artifact.

digest.description: Content hash of the artifact as collected, e.g. 'sha256:<hex>'. Re-hashing the artifact and comparing to this value establishes the content is unchanged since the digest was recorded — not that it was computed at collected_at.

collected_at.description: When the artifact was collected and its digest recorded (RFC 3339, UTC). Producer-asserted unless externally anchored. An artifact whose collected_at is later than the decision it supports could not have informed that decision.

source.description: Where the artifact came from — a URI, path, endpoint, or a described origin. What a reviewer would go to in order to re-collect it.

collector.description: The agent, tool, or party that collected the artifact and computed the digest. A digest is only as trustworthy as its collector unless independently re-derived.

media_type.description: Optional IANA media type of the artifact (e.g. 'text/plain', 'image/png').

size_bytes.description: Optional size of the artifact in bytes as collected.

collection_method.description: Optional description of how it was collected (e.g. 'http_get', 'file_read', 'screenshot', 'api_response').
